props.content:
### Summary (evidence-only)

Transcript reveals three failure classes: setup-time infra failures; messaging/delivery failures; and durability/design gaps (sandbox-only artifacts + no outbox). The simplest consistent explanation for lost deliverables is missing persistence before sandbox teardown.

Confidence notes: 'High' indicates code and transcript directly align (verified). 'Medium' indicates code paths suggest the mechanism but raw protected logs or provider responses are absent. All items cite transcript lines and repository code examples where present.
